title: Decision-readiness register: one row per requirement in the brief

status_vocabulary.done: the artefact exists and its number is published
status_vocabulary.partial: some of it exists; the missing part is named
status_vocabulary.blocked: a named gate stops it; the clearing number is stated
status_vocabulary.closed as designed: the requirement is met by refusing to open something
status_vocabulary.gate still closed: the requirement is itself a gate that has not passed
status_vocabulary.adopted as a rejection: the requirement is a prohibition, and it is kept
